primary_battery_level.low: PRI battery critically low — return to HAB or switch to SEC battery IMMEDIATELY.
primary_battery_level.below_nominal: PRI battery below nominal — monitor consumption & plan for swap/recharge.
primary_battery_level.above_nominal: PRI battery above nominal — no action needed.
primary_battery_level.high: PRI battery reading unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

secondary_battery_level.low: SEC battery critically low — return to HAB or switch to PRI battery IMMEDIATELY.
secondary_battery_level.below_nominal: SEC battery below nominal — monitor consumption & plan for swap/recharge.
secondary_battery_level.above_nominal: SEC battery above nominal — no action needed.
secondary_battery_level.high: SEC battery reading unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

battery_level.low: Battery critically low — return to HAB or connect to external power source immediately.
battery_level.below_nominal: Battery below nominal — monitor consumption & plan for recharge.
battery_level.above_nominal: Battery above nominal — no action needed.
battery_level.high: Battery reading unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxy_pri_storage.low: PRI O2 storage critically low — switch to SEC supply & terminate EVA.
oxy_pri_storage.below_nominal: PRI O2 storage below nominal — monitor consumption & prepare contingency.
oxy_pri_storage.above_nominal: PRI O2 storage above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_pri_storage.high: PRI O2 storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxy_sec_storage.low: SEC O2 storage critically low — terminate EVA or switch to PRI supply IMMEDIATELY.
oxy_sec_storage.below_nominal: SEC O2 storage below nominal — monitor consumption & prepare to terminate EVA.
oxy_sec_storage.above_nominal: SEC O2 storage above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_sec_storage.high: SEC O2 storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxy_pri_pressure.low: PRI O2 pressure critically low — switch to SEC O2 & terminate EVA.
oxy_pri_pressure.below_nominal: PRI O2 pressure below nominal — monitor & prepare to switch to SEC supply.
oxy_pri_pressure.above_nominal: PRI O2 pressure above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_pri_pressure.high: PRI O2 pressure dangerously high — risk of regulator failure; switch to SEC supply immediately.

oxy_sec_pressure.low: SEC O2 pressure critically low — switch to PRI O2 & terminate EVA.
oxy_sec_pressure.below_nominal: SEC O2 pressure below nominal — inspect SEC regulator.
oxy_sec_pressure.above_nominal: SEC O2 pressure above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_sec_pressure.high: SEC O2 pressure dangerously high — risk of regulator failure; do not use SEC supply.

suit_pressure_oxy.low: Suit O2 pressure critically low — swap to PRI/SEC O2 tank & return to PR IMMEDIATELY.
suit_pressure_oxy.below_nominal: Suit O2 pressure below nominal — monitor breathing comfort & check O2 flow.
suit_pressure_oxy.above_nominal: Suit O2 pressure above nominal — check O2 regulator for over-delivery.
suit_pressure_oxy.high: Suit O2 partial pressure dangerously high — swap to PRI/SEC O2 tank & return to PR IMMEDIATELY.

suit_pressure_co2.low: Suit CO2 pressure below range — verify scrubber function & sensor calibration.
suit_pressure_co2.below_nominal: Suit CO2 pressure below nominal — verify scrubber is not over-performing.
suit_pressure_co2.above_nominal: Suit CO2 pressure above nominal — monitor scrubber efficiency & metabolic rate.
suit_pressure_co2.high: Suit CO2 pressure critically high — vent scrubber IMMEDIATELY.

suit_pressure_other.low: Suit other gas pressure below range — check suit integrity & sensor calibration.
suit_pressure_other.below_nominal: Suit other gas pressure below nominal — monitor suit atmosphere composition.
suit_pressure_other.above_nominal: Suit other gas pressure above nominal — prepare for decompress sequence.
suit_pressure_other.high: Suit other gas pressure critically high — begin decompress sequence; if still high, return to PR IMMEDIATELY.

suit_pressure_total.low: Total suit pressure critically low — O2 tank or scrubber problem; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.
suit_pressure_total.below_nominal: Total suit pressure slightly below nominal — possible suit breach; investigate O2 tank or scrubber.
suit_pressure_total.above_nominal: Total suit pressure above nominal — check pressure regulation system.
suit_pressure_total.high: Total suit pressure dangerously high — O2 tank or scrubber problem; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.

helmet_pressure_co2.low: Helmet CO2 pressure below range — verify sensor calibration.
helmet_pressure_co2.below_nominal: Helmet CO2 pressure below nominal — fan(s) over-performing; verify sensor.
helmet_pressure_co2.above_nominal: Helmet CO2 pressure above nominal — increase fan RPM(s) & monitor scrubber performance.
helmet_pressure_co2.high: Helmet CO2 pressure critically high — hypercapnia risk; fan failure; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.

fan_pri_rpm.low: PRI fan RPM critically low — fan failure or ventilation compromised; switch to SEC fan; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.
fan_pri_rpm.below_nominal: PRI fan RPM below nominal — check PRI fan motor & power supply.
fan_pri_rpm.above_nominal: PRI fan RPM above nominal — fan running faster than expected; monitor for overheating.
fan_pri_rpm.high: PRI fan RPM dangerously high — PRI fan failure; switch to SEC fan; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.

fan_sec_rpm.low: SEC fan RPM critically low — fan failure or ventilation compromised; switch to PRI fan; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.
fan_sec_rpm.below_nominal: SEC fan RPM below nominal — check SEC fan motor & power supply.
fan_sec_rpm.above_nominal: SEC fan RPM above nominal — fan running faster than expected; monitor for overheating.
fan_sec_rpm.high: SEC fan RPM dangerously high — SEC fan failure; switch to PRI fan; return to PR IMMEDIATELY.

scrubber_a_co2_storage.low: Scrubber A CO2 storage below range — verify sensor calibration.
scrubber_a_co2_storage.below_nominal: Scrubber A CO2 storage below nominal — no action needed.
scrubber_a_co2_storage.above_nominal: Scrubber A CO2 storage above nominal — prepare to vent Scrubber A CO2.
scrubber_a_co2_storage.high: Scrubber A CO2 storage at capacity — switch to Scrubber B & replace Scrubber A immediately.

scrubber_b_co2_storage.low: Scrubber B CO2 storage below range — verify sensor calibration.
scrubber_b_co2_storage.below_nominal: Scrubber B CO2 storage below nominal — no action needed.
scrubber_b_co2_storage.above_nominal: Scrubber B CO2 storage above nominal — prepare to vent Scrubber B CO2.
scrubber_b_co2_storage.high: Scrubber B CO2 storage at capacity — switch to Scrubber A & replace Scrubber B immediately.

temperature.low: Suit temperature critically low — risk of hypothermia; increase heating IMMEDIATELY.
temperature.below_nominal: Suit temperature below nominal — check heater settings & increase if needed.
temperature.above_nominal: Suit temperature above nominal — reduce physical actvity or increase cooling.
temperature.high: Suit temperature dangerously high — risk of heat stroke; reduce physical activity & increase cooling IMMEDIATELY.

coolant_storage.low: Coolant storage critically low — thermal regulation at risk; reduce activity & return to PR.
coolant_storage.below_nominal: Coolant storage below nominal — monitor coolant consumption rate.
coolant_storage.above_nominal: Coolant storage above nominal — no action needed.
coolant_storage.high: Coolant storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

coolant_gas_pressure.low: Coolant gas pressure below range — check coolant system integrity.
coolant_gas_pressure.below_nominal: Coolant gas pressure below nominal — verify coolant gas reservoir.
coolant_gas_pressure.above_nominal: Coolant gas pressure above nominal — check for blockage in coolant gas lines.
coolant_gas_pressure.high: Coolant gas pressure dangerously high — risk of line rupture; reduce pressure immediately.

coolant_liquid_pressure.low: Coolant liquid pressure critically low — pump may be failing; thermal regulation at risk.
coolant_liquid_pressure.below_nominal: Coolant liquid pressure below nominal — check coolant pump & lines for leaks.
coolant_liquid_pressure.above_nominal: Coolant liquid pressure above nominal — check for blockage in coolant liquid lines.
coolant_liquid_pressure.high: Coolant liquid pressure dangerously high — risk of line rupture; check coolant pump & valves.

heart_rate.low: Heart rate critically low — possible medical emergency; halt EVA & prepare for EV rescue.
heart_rate.below_nominal: Heart rate below nominal — monitor EV condition.
heart_rate.above_nominal: Heart rate above nominal — monitor EV condition & reduce physical activity.
heart_rate.high: Heart rate dangerously high — possible medical emergency; halt EVA & prepare for EV rescue.

oxy_consumption.low: Oxygen consumption rate below range — verify sensor & check EV is breathing normally.
oxy_consumption.below_nominal: Oxygen consumption below nominal — monitor EV activity level.
oxy_consumption.above_nominal: Oxygen consumption above nominal — high metabolic rate; reduce activity.
oxy_consumption.high: Oxygen consumption critically high — O2 supply will deplete faster; reduce activity & plan return to PR.

co2_production.low: CO2 production rate below range — verify sensor calibration.
co2_production.below_nominal: CO2 production below nominal — monitor EV activity level.
co2_production.above_nominal: CO2 production above nominal — high metabolic rate; reduce activity & monitor scrubber performance.
co2_production.high: CO2 production critically high — scrubber may be overwhelmed; reduce activity & monitor helmet CO2 levels.

throttle.low: Rover throttle below range — verify throttle control system.
throttle.below_nominal: Rover throttle below nominal — no action needed unless unexpected.
throttle.above_nominal: Rover throttle above nominal — monitor speed & terrain conditions.
throttle.high: Rover throttle at maximum — reduce speed for uneven terrain or present obstacles.

steering.low: Rover steering at full left lock — verify intentional & check for steering system faults.
steering.below_nominal: Rover steering left of nominal — verify intentional.
steering.above_nominal: Rover steering right of nominal — verify intentional.
steering.high: Rover steering at full right lock — verify intentional & check for steering system faults.

pitch.low: Rover pitch critically negative — steep downhill grade; reduce speed to prevent tipping.
pitch.below_nominal: Rover pitch below nominal — monitor terrain slope.
pitch.above_nominal: Rover pitch above nominal — monitor terrain slope.
pitch.high: Rover pitch critically positive — steep uphill grade; reduce speed & check traction.

roll.low: Rover roll below range — verify sensor calibration.
roll.below_nominal: Rover roll below nominal — terrain is level; no action needed.
roll.above_nominal: Rover roll above nominal — monitor lateral stability on uneven terrain.
roll.high: Rover roll critically high — risk of rollover; reduce speed & steer toward level ground immediately.

distance_traveled.low: Rover distance traveled below range — verify odometer sensor.
distance_traveled.below_nominal: Rover distance traveled below nominal — no action needed.
distance_traveled.above_nominal: Rover distance traveled above nominal — monitor mission timeline.
distance_traveled.high: Rover distance traveled at limit — evaluate PR battery & O2 before continuing.

speed.low: Rover speed below range — verify speed sensor calibration.
speed.below_nominal: Rover speed below nominal — no action needed.
speed.above_nominal: Rover speed above nominal — monitor terrain conditions.
speed.high: Rover speed critically high — reduce speed immediately; risk of loss of control on lunar terrain.

surface_incline.low: Surface incline critically steep downward — reduce speed immediately to prevent loss of control.
surface_incline.below_nominal: Surface incline below nominal — monitor terrain descent.
surface_incline.above_nominal: Surface incline above nominal — monitor terrain ascent.
surface_incline.high: Surface incline critically steep upward — rover may lose traction; reduce speed & assess route.

oxygen_storage.low: Rover O2 storage critically low — return to HAB IMMEDIATELY to resupply.
oxygen_storage.below_nominal: Rover O2 storage below nominal — monitor consumption & plan HAB return timeline.
oxygen_storage.above_nominal: Rover O2 storage above nominal — no action needed.
oxygen_storage.high: Rover O2 storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxygen_pressure.low: Rover O2 pressure critically low — O2 regulator may be failing.
oxygen_pressure.below_nominal: Rover O2 pressure below nominal — inspect O2 regulator & lines.
oxygen_pressure.above_nominal: Rover O2 pressure above nominal — check regulator for over-pressure.
oxygen_pressure.high: Rover O2 pressure dangerously high — risk of regulator failure; reduce pressure immediately.

cabin_pressure.low: Rover cabin pressure critically low — possible breach; don suits & begin emergency protocol.
cabin_pressure.below_nominal: Rover cabin pressure slightly below nominal — inspect cabin seals.
cabin_pressure.above_nominal: Rover cabin pressure above nominal — check pressure regulation system.
cabin_pressure.high: Rover cabin pressure dangerously high — risk of structural failure; vent pressure immediately.

cabin_temperature.low: Rover cabin temperature critically low — risk of hypothermia; activate cabin heating.
cabin_temperature.below_nominal: Rover cabin temperature below nominal — increase heating.
cabin_temperature.above_nominal: Rover cabin temperature above nominal — no action needed unless approaching limit.
cabin_temperature.high: Rover cabin temperature critically high — risk of heat exhaustion; activate cabin cooling.

coolant_pressure.low: Rover coolant pressure critically low — coolant pump may be failing; reduce system load.
coolant_pressure.below_nominal: Rover coolant pressure below nominal — check coolant pump & inspect for leaks.
coolant_pressure.above_nominal: Rover coolant pressure above nominal — check for blockage in coolant lines.
coolant_pressure.high: Rover coolant pressure dangerously high — risk of line rupture; shut down coolant pump & investigate.

distance_from_base.low: Rover distance from HAB below range — verify GPS sensor.
distance_from_base.below_nominal: Rover distance from HAB below nominal — no action needed.
distance_from_base.above_nominal: Rover distance from HAB above nominal — monitor return route feasibility.
distance_from_base.high: Rover distance from HAB at limit — turn back immediately to ensure safe return with remaining resources.

oxygen_tank.low: Rover O2 tank critically low — return to HAB for resupply immediately.
oxygen_tank.below_nominal: Rover O2 tank below nominal — monitor O2 usage rate & adjust mission timeline.
oxygen_tank.above_nominal: Rover O2 tank above nominal — no action needed.
oxygen_tank.high: Rover O2 tank unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.
